changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.

changes.summary: Materialized writable state and output directories without build-time Linux capabilities.
changes.details: The Dockerfile now creates /state and /outputs through deterministic COPY layers, so its rootless, capability-free RUN step works with the read-only root directory in the pinned Anemll base image.

changes.summary: Made the image build compatible with the rootless capability-dropped builder.
changes.details: Physical Spark evidence showed that the Docker-compatible adapter failed under the agent's rootless Podman boundary. Directory creation no longer requests chown capability during RUN, and the final image now declares the required ai.vonkforge.runtime-interface=v1 label. Runtime sources, model, topology, and serving parameters are unchanged.

changes.summary: Raised the bounded build staging envelope for the pinned Anemll base image.
changes.details: A physical Spark build proved that the previous 16 GB temporary allowance could not hold the verified 9.79 GB compressed base-image archive and its expanded rootless Podman graph at the same time. The recipe now reserves 64 GB of temporary build storage; model, runtime, image source, topology, and serving behavior are unchanged.

changes.summary: Advanced the Mia native-Vision runtime contract to c444d703.
changes.details: Vendors the current Vision-Exp routing, image-layout cache, narrow RGB CHW, and quoted-tag role fixes plus the issue-117 shared-memory ring recovery backport. The measured TP2 defaults now use cudagraph capture size 48 and two in-flight prefills. The official model snapshot remains byte-pinned at Hugging Face 6821d6ad; Candidate status remains until this exact image passes physical two-Spark image acceptance.

changes.summary: Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.
Advanced the official Vision-Exp snapshot to Hugging Face 6821d6ad.
changes.details: The 84-file snapshot is refreshed from e46e16bf to 6821d6ad. All model payloads and configuration files are byte-identical; only the upstream README changed, increasing the exact inventory by 1,506 bytes. The pinned MiaAI-Lab de230b45 runtime patch, topology, and Candidate acceptance state remain unchanged; installed containers must be recreated.

changes.summary: Added the official native-vision DeepSeek V4 Flash Experimental dual-Spark Candidate.
changes.details: Pins all 84 files and 167,831,847,285 bytes at official revision e46e16bf, then reproduces MiaAI-Lab 7963d432 on the immutable Anemll ARM64 runtime with OpenAI image_url input, the official 32-layer ViT and aligner, NVFP4 DS-MLA KV, DSpark K6, TP2, and the measured 1M profile. The older Mia single-Spark repository remains a text-only 0731 EXL3 lane, so no unsupported Vision single-Spark recipe is claimed.
